why_matters.factory: High mint volume from one owner can inflate registry counts without corresponding feedback.
why_matters.downvote: A single day with many low scores may indicate coordinated activity rather than individual reviews.
why_matters.reviewer: Reviewers that touch hundreds of agents with similar scores behave unlike typical users.
why_matters.agent: Composite scores depend on review count, timing, and reviewer overlap.
why_matters.collision: Multiple agents sharing one ENS name breaks one-name-one-agent assumptions.
why_matters.mintspike: Large single-day mint spikes often correlate with factory wallets.
why_matters.ghost: Agents with zero feedback carry no reputation signal.
why_matters.integrity: Out-of-range scores are excluded from aggregates and flagged for ingest review.
